newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Arquati closes public offer, oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Arquati closes public offer, oversubscribed.

text.p: Italy's Arquati company which makes picture frames, curtains and awnings said in a statement that it had closed its public share offer on February 4 after the offer was oversubscribed.
The Parma-based family firm, which hopes to list on the Milan bourse in the second half of February, said the public offer of shares was three times oversubscribed.
The public offer was for four million ordinary shares priced at 2,250 lire each, while the total global offer is for 13.3 million shares equal to around one third of the group's capital.
The group posted first half 1996 net profit of 3.1 billion lire on a turnover of 79 billion lire.
